cim: AI Beta Testers Wanted: Automate Your Business
cim_eredeti: AI Beta Testers Wanted: Automate Your Business
szoveg_eredeti:
For the last few months, I've been doing something that has completely changed how I run my businesses. I set up agentic AI to handle the parts of business I've always hated: email, bills, bookkeeping, taxes, client follow-ups and advertising. It watches everything, it never forgets anything, and when it needs me, it asks a quick question and I tap an answer.

I'm turning that system into software that I'll be selling, but before it launches, I'm giving it away 100% free to a small group of beta testers.

Here's exactly who I'm looking for. You need to meet all of these:

If that's you, email me at lee@fstoppers.com with the subject "AI Onboarding" and a few sentences about your business and why you want in. If you're a good fit, I'll give you the software for free.
